description: Change the image of a CarlNotes topic you may edit to the public jpeg, png, or webp at image_url. The previous image is deleted. Carl renders a new image only from the topic page, so to regenerate the image, send the user to the topic page. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to change a topic's image, with phrases like change the topic image, regenerate the image, or use this picture.

image_url.description: A public jpeg, png, or webp to use as the topic's image.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.

name: set_topic_image
title: Change a topic's image
